ProofData.statement: Defines the structure $\mathrm{ProofData}(a,q,K,\sigma_1,\sigma_2,F,G)$ on $X$, bundling the data (a natural number $a$, a real $q$, a kernel $K:X\times X\to\mathbb C$, functions $\sigma_1,\sigma_2:X\to\mathbb Z$ and sets $F,G\subseteq X$) and assumptions common to most of Chapters 2–7 (except Chapter 3).

ProofData.toKernelProofData.statement: The kernel data $\mathrm{KernelProofData}(a,K)$ underlying a $\mathrm{ProofData}$ structure.

ProofData.Q.statement: The simple function $Q:X\to\Theta(X)$ that is part of a $\mathrm{ProofData}$ structure.

defaultS.statement: Defines the natural number $S=\mathrm{defaultS}(X)$ associated with the space $X$.
